name: Grade 9 IT Practice: May Week 9 - Robot Design
description: Practice words for Grade 9 first-trimester physical computing work.

words.example: The robot goal was to detect an object and give a warning signal.

words.definition: A list of parts needed for a project.
words.example: The component list included the sensor, LED, resistor, and buzzer.

words.definition: A table or diagram showing states and actions.
words.example: The state chart showed what the robot should do when the sensor changed.

words.definition: A plan for building and testing a project.
words.example: The design plan explained the inputs, outputs, and test steps.

words.definition: One action used to check if something works.
words.example: The first test step checked whether the sensor reading appeared.

words.definition: Peer or teacher comments used to refine the robot goal, design, or evidence plan.
words.example: Peer feedback helped the team simplify the robot goal.
